title: MRI data-consistency projection commutation audit
amendment: 01 — correct the DC implementation and residual metric to use a unitary constant-sensitivity SENSE operator whose normal operator is identity, replace measured k-space samples, then apply the exact adjoint. The initial exploratory spatially-varying sensitivity code did not implement an exact projection; no results from that attempt are reported as evidence. Gates and seeds are unchanged.
hypothesis: Post-DC nontrivial feature Mirror views violate acquired-sample consistency, while the same views before a final exact projection preserve it; projected views may or may not improve heldout quality.
physical_object: one frozen small two-coil convolutional prior
mirror_coordinate: two fixed Givens angles acting on two hidden feature planes
logical_multiplicity: alternative prior functional views at three locations relative to exact data consistency
controls: plain zero-filled input with exact DC
pre-prior-feature Mirror then exact final DC

development.selection_metric: acquired-line residual, heldout-line residual, image NMSE; no tuning on target truth
development.operator_amendment: unit-norm spatially constant two-coil sensitivity per site, making S^H S=I and one measured k-space overwrite an exact image projection

success_gate: Each projected view has acquired-line residual <=1e-6 and >=5% lower heldout-line error than the stronger prior-then-DC control on all three target scans.
failure_gate: Post-DC view has acquired-line residual >1e-4, or the projected Mirror does not meet the heldout quality gate against prior-then-DC.
